Amazon's company disclosure reports $5.447 billion of operating-income growth after depreciation. Its broader cash-flow adjustment cannot be treated as depreciation alone.

Meta's company filing reports $5.32 billion of operating-income growth after expenses and an approximately $1.84 billion depreciation increase.

reviews.rationale: All four companies report material operating-income growth after depreciation. Rising depreciation is a real expense, but it did not consume their growth under the contract's fair plain reading. Reported operating income already includes that expense.
